description: This Java class 'SetupProfileFragment' handles the initiation of managed profile provisioning within an Android application. It creates a fragment with a button that, when clicked, starts the device management provisioning process, handles the result, and displays appropriate toast messages.

classes.name: SetupProfileFragment
classes.description: A Fragment responsible for initiating managed profile provisioning on an Android device. Includes UI handling and intent management for device provisioning.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of SetupProfileFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout for setting up the profile.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the click listener for the provisioning button.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, specifically initiating managed profile provisioning.

methods.name: provisionManagedProfile
methods.description: Starts the device provisioning intent if the device supports it, and finishes the activity.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the provisioning activity, showing success or failure messages.
